page_title: FRO 2-1 ATA | Frosinone v Atalanta 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Juan Musso guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
90+5' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
90+3' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+3' An attempted cross from Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.

90+1' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the top left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Michele Cerofolini, who keeps it out.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
84' The corner from Luis Muriel evades the keeper, but Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar.
84' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) will take the corner.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Walid Cheddira will be replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
82' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Abdou Harroui and he is replaced by Przemyslaw Szyminski (Frosinone).
81' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Luis Muriel (Atalanta) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
81' Substitution. Matteo Ruggeri did his best and is replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
80' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates.
78' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) will take a corner kick.
77' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Luis Muriel (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Berat Djimsiti.

75' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from deep inside the box. His effort flies well wide of the left post!
74' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

69' A pass travels right across the box to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Michele Cerofolini denies him with a decent save.
68' Substitution. Duvan Zapata leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
65' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

65' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
64' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Michele Cerofolini easily deals with the threat.
64' Walid Cheddira races towards the box before laying off to Luca Garritano (Frosinone), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
63' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
61' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
60' Substitution. Luca Garritano (Frosinone) in, Jaime Baez Stabile out.
60' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) is penalised for holding. Juan Luca Sacchi signals a set piece. Atalanta have a free kick.
59' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.

58' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
56' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Ederson tees up Duvan Zapata (Atalanta) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Michele Cerofolini.
55' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
54' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

52' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Michele Cerofolini, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.

51' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
49' Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Nadir Zortea has come on in place of Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Juan Luca Sacchi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+4' The game is interrupted. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

45+3' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Juan Musso. This effort really didn't trouble him.
45+1' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Juan Musso has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
42' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
40' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
37' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
36' Atalanta are ruled offside.
35' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' The total number of attempts is 4:5. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.
30' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
28' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) for his blatant foul.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' 2 - 0 Goal! Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
23' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

23' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.

20' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
19' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
17' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
14' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
13' Duvan Zapata (Atalanta) receives a reproachful look from Ademola Lookman. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the left post.

12' Juan Musso doesn't have to worry about that one. Riccardo Marchizza puts a cross in towards Francesco Gelli (Frosinone), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Frosinone.
8' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.

3' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) finds Walid Cheddira with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Francesco Gelli. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Frosinone will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
